{{Top|leg}}
A '''skip tracer''' was a slang term for a collections agent, a person charged with finding those who had "skipped" out on their debts. [[Interstellar Collections Limited/Legends|Interstellar Collections Limited]] maintained the infamous [[Red List/Legends|Red List]], a collection of outstanding debts and the persons who owed them.

[[Odumin]], territorial sector manager for the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], disguised himself as a skip tracer named Spray to manipulate the young [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] into helping break-up a [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] operation. Supposedly working for Interstellar Collections Limited, he insisted on staying aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to secure the company's interest in the [[Starship/Legends|ship]].
